recipes.oracle_text: When this creature enters, you gain 3 life.

recipe_coverage: Reviewed unconditional entry draw/life component: structured Oracle casting cost and base stats, exact payment and insufficient/wrong-color negatives, ordered draws and explicit life gain/loss, both controllers and injured life totals, two copies, legal bounce and recast, blink and repeated entry, countered creature spells, death and bounce without re-entry, unrelated creature entry, cleanup without repeat, pre-cast and pending-spell snapshot replay after AI backups, stocked owned zones with deliberate empty variants and final-card library draws. Additional keyword interactions, optional triggers, variable effects, multiple simultaneous triggers, alternate costs, draw replacement/prevention, empty-library loss, and AI policy remain gaps. Component coverage, not whole-card certification.
